excluded_plans.description: Plans not offered as presets (S16 AC-9); registered manually.

plans.description: Plans and their phases in the release file's order; sizes inside a phase ascending by `size_amount` (5.4.0, Torno).

phase.description: Research format phases; the UI translates them.

items.description: One size of a plan/phase in the current release.

not_confirmed_count.description: The number of DISTINCT rule fields (`RuleField`) with status `not_confirmed` in any of the preset's rule sets. A field that is not confirmed on two platforms counts once. `stored_only` data and stances are not counted (5.4.0, Torno).

size_amount.description: Account size in `currency` (decimal string, at most 2 decimals, > 0). Zero fails the pattern: 400 `common.invalid_request`.

code.description: Code of the firm-side platform when the preset has platform-specific rules (e.g. `rithmic`, `tradovate`); the options come from the preset version (S16). Not the execution platform.

manual_only.description: 5.4.0 (S-R3-2/S-R3-4, data from the preset release): this firm platform cannot be reached by any V1 output. An account with this `firm_platform` is manual only (routing `routing.account_manual_only`, listed in `listRouteCandidates.manual_only`), like a firm-level `manual_only`.

reason.description: A verbatim quote of the firm's official text, in the firm's language (never translated). Plain text — clients render it as text, never as HTML or Markdown (QA Security I2).

section.description: Heading of the quoted part of the page, if any.

stances.description:
`automation` / `copy` are the rule versions of the opt-ins: one entry without `firm_platform` when
the stance is the same on every platform, otherwise one entry per firm platform. `vps` ∈ allowed /
forbidden / conditional / unknown / not_confirmed; `personal_device` ∈ required / not_required /
unknown / not_confirmed (Q-S16-2; `not_confirmed` from 5.4.0, S16 AC-5, Q-S16-7: the firm's pages
disagree, so at least 2 quotes and nothing is prefilled).

change.description: Present when this version replaced an earlier one for the same preset selection and kind.

cause.description:
`stance_changed` and `text_changed` move `chosen` accounts to `pending_review` (Q26; the
text case is Q42: the publisher flagged it as material). `not_material` never
suspends (typo or format fix).

previous_firm_stance.description: Stance of the rule version for the opt-in kind. A missing stance in the preset, and every prop account without a preset (generic rule, Q40), is `unknown`.

reason.description: The publisher's explanation shown to the user, present with `text_changed` (Q42 a: the publisher flags the change and records why); optional in the schema for compatibility.

firm_platform.description: The firm platform this rule version applies to; absent when the firm's stance does not vary by platform, and for generic rules.

firm_stance.description: Stance of the rule version for the opt-in kind. A missing stance in the preset, and every prop account without a preset (generic rule, Q40), is `unknown`.

is_generic.description: True for the rule used by prop accounts without a preset (no firm, stance `unknown`, no quotes; the UI shows the generic warning).

quotes.description:

conflicting quotes, each with its own source and date.
